Admissions
Admissions
The mission of the Biomedical Sciences (BIMS) Undergraduate Program at Texas A&M in Veterinary Medicine & Biomedical Sciences (VMBS) is to educate students who will create a healthier future for humans and animals through the medical professions, biomedical innovation and discovery, global service, and outreach.
Freshmen Applicants
Freshman applicants are students who have not yet attended college.
Change of Major
Change of Major applicants are students currently enrolled at Texas A&M University in a different program.
